title: Design: A/R Collection with groups closed matches the pictures in both themes
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on.
  • At least ten customers have overdue invoices on today's date, each with a phone number and a credit term.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom, with every group collapsed.
  • The design pictures "Info icon beside the title, light" (ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-light.png) and "Info icon beside the title, dark" (ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-dark.png) are attached to this case and open beside the browser at 100% zoom; compare the layout, labels and styles, not the names and amounts, which are only examples.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the title row and the filter row with the light picture.
  2. Look at the chevron in the table's top-left header cell.
  3. Compare the customer group rows with the light picture.
  4. Compare the Totals row with the light picture.
  5. Switch ShopView to dark theme.
  6. Compare the page with the dark picture.
  7. Widen the browser window to 1536 px and look across the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the title "A/R Aging Collection", the info icon directly right of it and the "⋯" at the right end, all on one line; the filter row below.
  • Step 2: it points right: every group is closed.
  • Step 3: each group row: a blue chevron pointing right, the bold name with its count, grey "Phone: " and the number and "Credit term: " and the term, "Total" under Past due and the two bold sums.
  • Step 4: "Totals" with the two bold sums at the bottom.
  • Step 5: the page switches to dark theme.
  • Step 6: as in the dark picture: dark page and white text; the "As of" and "Location" chips are dark-blue pills with white text; "Customer" and "Past due" are white text with no fill; Phone and Credit term grey; everything readable.
  • Step 7: nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped; the layout is the same as at 1440 px.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S8-R1: “Each report has the native report info icon (the one Work In Progress and Technician Utilization use) directly right of its title. Hovering, keyboard focus or a tap shows the report's description in a tooltip; moving away or Escape closes it. The descriptions:”
  • S8-R2: “The title, its info icon and the Export menu stay on one line at 1440 pixels wide; the filter row sits below them, positioned as on the native reports.”
  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”
  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-light.png: figure "Info icon beside the title, light" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p6-info-icon-beside-the-title-dark.png: figure "Info icon beside the title, dark" (This build (after)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column"
  • ar-ap-p7-a-r-collection-date-and-customer-only.png: figure "A/R Collection: date and customer only" (Production (before)), board "7. Filters and call list" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "The native report info icon sits right of the title; title, icon and ⋯ stay on one line, filter row below. S8-R1, S8-R2." (caption of "Info icon beside the title, light")
  • "Same in dark mode. S8-R1." (caption of "Info icon beside the title, dark")
  • "Collection and Unpaid Invoices have a customer or vendor picker, and their Totals row ignores it. No phone or credit term on the customer rows." (caption of "A/R Collection: date and customer only")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05): the PRD says "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. This case follows the PRD; the difference is question 15 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is held in D-80.
